recommended_action: Reject the proposal to pass and clear the alert. Immediately isolate STOR_NODE_06 from client traffic to perform integrity verification and block-level consistency checks for data/journal corruption. Update automation tooling to enforce mandatory pre-execution gating that aborts CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM whenever active client handles exceed zero or dirty write buffers remain unflushed.
